content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271, the cardiac event monitoring study, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9 and I48.0. As the note states, the study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and guide anticoagulation management. We therefore request reconsideration of the denied balance of 349.19 for CPT 93271."}
